comment: Input for build/sbom.sh: the third-party code bundled with APR and the
external libraries the UNIX build may link against.
bundled[]: files    source files (shell patterns) containing the code
license  SPDX expression; for tagged files it selects the
file-level tag or the snippet that belongs to this
entry, and licenses and copyrights are read from it
tagged   false for files we do not edit (upstream copies and
generated files); license and copyright come from
this entry and from extract
extract  values read from a file with a sed -n expression:
version, copyright, or any other name (a property)
if-present  only listed when the files exist
scope    required (default), optional or excluded (build only)
objects  objects containing the code (build SBOM); - means
the code is installed as a header
upstream "maintained" if the code comes from a maintained,
versioned project whose advisories could apply;
"historical" if it was forked long ago or has no
upstream left.  The build SBOM lists only
maintained code; the source SBOM lists everything.
component  CycloneDX component fields
external[]: libs    library names provided by this library: NAME as in
-lNAME and libNAME.so.N
pkg-config  modules to ask for the version in the build
SBOM, with component fields to use when found
define   apr_private.h macro that includes it in the build
SBOM (instead of libs)
compile-only  headers only: not a runtime component
component  CycloneDX component fields (source SBOM)
glibc:     library names (shell patterns) provided by the GNU C library
when building on it, including the dynamic loader
scan-exclude: files never checked for unclaimed SPDX tags

supplier.name: The Regents of the University of California

component.name: BSD getopt
component.description: Command line option parser behind apr_getopt().

pedigree.notes: Derived from the BSD C library getopt(3) and adapted to APR.

supplier.name: The Regents of the University of California

component.name: BSD mktemp
component.description: Temporary file creation behind apr_file_mktemp().

pedigree.notes: Derived from the BSD C library mktemp(3) and adapted to APR.

supplier.name: The Regents of the University of California

component.name: BSD strtoq
component.description: 64-bit string to integer conversion in apr_strtoi64().

pedigree.notes: Derived from the BSD C library strtoq(3) and adapted to APR.

supplier.name: The Regents of the University of California

component.name: BSD fnmatch.h
component.description: Public header declaring apr_fnmatch().

pedigree.notes: Derived from the BSD C library fnmatch.h; the implementation in strings/apr_fnmatch.c has since been rewritten.

component.name: ISC inet_ntop/inet_pton
component.description: IPv4/IPv6 address text conversion.

pedigree.notes: Derived from the ISC BIND resolver library and adapted to APR.

component.name: strnatcmp
component.description: Natural order string comparison in apr_strnatcmp() and apr_strnatcasecmp().

pedigree.notes: Adapted to APR from Martin Pool's strnatcmp.c.

component.name: UNIX V7 cvt
component.description: IEEE floating point formatting routines (apr_ecvt, apr_fcvt, apr_gcvt).

component.name: sha2
component.description: SHA-256 implementation used by the apr_random generator.

pedigree.notes: A licence to this code was granted to the ASF by Aaron D. Gifford on 4 November 2003; it is distributed under the Apache License 2.0.

component.name: AIX libdl emulation
component.description: dlopen() emulation used by apr_dso on AIX only.

pedigree.notes: Based on libdl (dlfcn.c/dlfcn.h) by Jens-Uwe Mager.

component.name: GNU config
component.description: Build system type detection scripts.

pedigree.notes: Copied unmodified from the GNU config project.

component.name: autoconf-archive AX_PROG_CC_FOR_BUILD
component.description: Autoconf macro locating a native compiler when cross-compiling.

pedigree.notes: Copied unmodified from the GNU Autoconf Archive.

component.name: GNU Libtool
component.description: Libtool support files copied in by buildconf (libtoolize); present in release tarballs.

pedigree.notes: Copied by libtoolize. The full version string shows whether a distribution-patched libtool was used.

component.name: GNU Autoconf
component.description: configure script generated by autoconf from configure.in; present in release tarballs.

pedigree.notes: Generated by buildconf; contains Autoconf-provided shell code.

component.name: libc
component.description: C standard library and POSIX interfaces.

component.name: libpthread
component.description: POSIX threads; part of libc on many systems; not used with --disable-threads.

component.name: libdl
component.description: dlopen()/dlsym() for apr_dso; part of libc on many systems; not used with --disable-dso.

component.name: libdld
component.description: shl_load() for apr_dso on HP-UX.

component.name: librt
component.description: shm_open() and sem_open() on systems where they are not in libc.

component.name: libuuid
component.description: OS UUID generator (uuid_generate() or uuid_create()); APR uses its own generator when absent.

component.name: libcrypt
component.description: crypt(); linked when configure finds it in a separate library.

component.name: libm
component.description: modf(); linked when it is not in libc.

component.name: libresolv
component.description: hstrerror(); linked when it is not in libc.

component.name: libnsl
component.description: gethostbyname() and gethostname() on systems where they are not in libc.

component.name: libsocket
component.description: BSD sockets on systems where they are not in libc (e.g. Solaris).

component.name: libinet6
component.description: getaddrinfo() and getnameinfo() on systems where they are not in libc.

component.name: libsendfile
component.description: sendfilev() on Solaris.

component.name: libbsd
component.description: random() on systems where it is not in libc.

component.name: libtruerand
component.description: TrueRand entropy source; linked when present.

component.name: Electric Fence
component.description: Malloc debugger; only with --with-efence.

component.name: Valgrind client headers
component.description: valgrind.h and memcheck.h, compiled in with --with-valgrind to annotate pool memory.

component.name: glibc
component.description: GNU C library, providing libc and the POSIX libraries linked by this build.
